Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Even if you trash it, you play this card without paying the cost.
Card Q&A.q: When this card is played without paying the cost, can I use its 1st effect to trash a specified card from my hand?

Effect: When this card would be played, by trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Ver.1] trait card from your hand, reduce the play cost by 2.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete up to 5000 DP total worth of your opponent's Digimon. For each of this Digimon's face-down digivolution cards, add 2000 to this effect's DP maximum.
Inherited Effect: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
